summary: Verified LIVE WhatsApp OTP mode. Backend POST /api/auth/otp/request returns 200 {ok:true, channel:'whatsapp', live:true, dev_code:null} (confirmed live MSG91 routing, not mock). otp/verify correctly rejects wrong codes with 400 'Invalid or expired code'. Frontend /otp-login sends OTP, advances to code-entry step (otp-code + otp-verify-btn visible) with NO dev-code box; shows the green channel note 'We sent a 6-digit code to your WhatsApp.'; resend cooldown timer works; wrong-code verify shows a friendly inline error (no crash); Change number returns to step 1. Email/password regression: demo@neksathi.app logs in and lands on /dashboard. Verify completion was intentionally not attempted (code only delivered over WhatsApp). 5/5 new backend tests pass, all frontend checks pass. Zero console/page errors other than the expected 400 from the deliberate wrong-code attempt.

issues: Minor UX: the phone number the code was sent to is not echoed on the code-entry screen, so users can't confirm the target number before entering the code (only 'Change number' is available).

action_items: Optional: echo the masked phone number on the OTP code-entry step for confirmation.

Optional: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md — the OTP section still documents mock mode with an on-screen dev_code; live WhatsApp mode no longer returns a code so OTP login cannot be used by automated testers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py otp_request live path stores the code before delivery; if comms.send_whatsapp_otp raises, a stale code remains in db.otp_codes for TTL. Consider deleting the stored code in the except branch.
server.py is very large (>6600 lines) — should be split into routers/modules per code-review guidelines.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_otp_login.py (added pytestmark skipif — its mock-mode dev_code assertions are invalid while live WhatsApp OTP is configured; 4 tests previously failed for this reason only, no product bug)
seed_data_creation: None. Live OTP request used +919812345678 (creates only a transient db.otp_codes row that expires in 10 min).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live WhatsApp OTP is enabled (MSG91_AUTHKEY + MSG91_WHATSAPP_NUMBER + MSG91_WHATSAPP_OTP_TEMPLATE in backend/.env), so dev_code is null and OTP login CANNOT be completed by automated tests. Use email/password (demo@neksathi.app / demo1234) for any authenticated flows. /api/auth/otp/request is rate limited to 5/minute — sleep ~40s between UI runs. test_otp_login.py auto-skips while live mode is on; it will re-enable if MSG91 whatsapp vars are removed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. The 4 failures in the pre-existing test_otp_login.py are stale mock-mode assumptions (they read response['dev_code'] which is null in live mode), not application bugs; gated with a skipif.
